summary:
I re-checked all 16 capabilities against origin/main 15e78e276 in the read-only ground worktree. vitest was not run because apps/reading/node_modules is absent. One status is wrong and four carry faulty or stale evidence; the other 15 statuses hold. C13 is BUILT_UNREACHABLE, not SPEC_ONLY: substrate/research_bridge/versioning.py:72-108 already forks a document into a new row with parent_document_id and version_root lineage, and the SDAM tables are installed code. Neither has a caller.

The four evidence corrections:
- C07: CommandPalette.tsx:446-454 also exposes 'Replay:' rows, so MyResearch is not the only replay entry.
- C09: twin-notes.html is linked in-app through the ResearchArtifactReceipt window opened by the Reader's 'Research this page'. That window's 'Artifact HTML' Open link 404s (RUN via TestClient). Its unit test pins the broken href.
- C16: PR #2838 is stale evidence. Evidence reader windows already landed on main (597f659a3, DRW index.tsx:410-441). The evidenceSourceContext prop has no consumer, and a highlight spawn inside that window still navigates the whole app away.
- C03: Write's sub-agent accept does spawn a child research but then drops its id. DRW Deepen only raises the budget; its follow_up field is stored and never consumed.

Capabilities the grounding missed:
- The AISidecar @-context picker (Cmd+/, POST /compose-context). It composes context from 'doc' and 'insight' items only, entered as raw ids, with no thread kind.
- The Cmd+[ / Cmd+] panel cycling and the per-investigation panel layout saved in localStorage. These are the nearest thing to herdr tabs.
- The workflow-scoped ProjectTree panel (Cmd+B).
- The write-only document.filed_into_investigation filing event. It records a document-to-project link that nothing reads.
- Loop One's continuous chase mode. It spawns child threads autonomously from open questions, but the UI cannot switch it on.

New defects:
- Write's Cmd+K edit uses String.replace on the first matching text, so it can edit the wrong passage.
- The source-merge and import-notes routes read a client-supplied server path with no confinement (PLAUSIBLE from READ, not RUN).
- The Reader's highlight Deep-research fails silently: the error only goes to console.error.

The grounding's core picture holds. The thread list is unreachable, follow-up with held context and automatic merge are absent, merge is a file-based view concatenation, the reuse pack is discarded, and the source-merge path mutates documents.raw_text in place.
